payload.objective: Build a deterministic economics harness for bounded first-dollar hardware experiments without starting any workload.
payload.scope: Compare measured or source-estimated reward rates against incremental electricity, payout thresholds, fees, liquidity and payout lag. Produce ranking evidence only; no install/start/sign/account/network/spend effect.
acceptance_criteria: Exact-resource measured observations are distinguished from source estimates.
Stale or malformed reward quotes fail closed.
Payout threshold and lag are represented explicitly.
Incremental wall-power cost and electricity break-even are calculated with Decimal arithmetic.
Estimated results cannot become workload authorization.
The harness can compare useful-compute and mining lanes on the same dollar basis.
